integrity: The proof is analytic. The focal preprint and the earlier phase-autoencoder paper were inspected directly. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an identifiability obstruction for information supported exactly on one stable limit cycle. It does not claim that a particular trained model must fail, and it does not apply when off-cycle trajectories, vector-field Jacobians, controlled perturbation responses, or restrictive justified model classes supply transverse information.
title: Limit-cycle-only phase data do not identify the full phase response curve
